children: David Baxley Spetzler, an officer serving as President, reported sales of Caris Life Sciences common stock effected in a broker-assisted sell-to-cover exercise of fully vested stock options. The transactions were reported at weighted average prices of $24.7604, $25.3201 and $24.7552 per share. The total sale amount reported was $14,834,106. The reporting person directly beneficially owns 1,182,871 shares of common stock following the reported transactions.
